subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh/rebased 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first accepted slice of the broader calendar request, or leave the feature issue open until a cleaner implementation appears?
rationale: The idea is useful and visually proven, but the current branch is stale, conflicting, and implements a product feature with compatibility-sensitive cron status and scheduler behavior that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Request a fresh/rebased PR
options.body: Ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against the current cron page that preserves current cron.status fields and derives timeline behavior from current scheduler/job state.

options.title: Adopt and repair this branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor the feature and own the larger rebase, scheduler-accuracy, compatibility, and generated-i18n cleanup work.

options.title: Defer the timeline feature
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open as product backlog and do not treat this stale branch as the landing path.

recommendation.title: Request a fresh/rebased PR
recommendation.body: Ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against the current cron page that preserves current cron.status fields and derives timeline behavior from current scheduler/job state.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest available routing signal across recent cron and Control UI history for this product-surface decision.
